auth.noRecoveryBody: If you forget your password, you lose access to every document forever — we have no way to recover them. That's what real end-to-end encryption means: not even we can open your keys.
auth.noRecoveryConfirm: I understand — forgetting my password means losing everything, permanently

login.quote: Write together with people you trust. Only you can read it.
login.subquote: Every document is scrambled before it leaves your computer.
login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: Welcome back.
login.keysHint: Your keys stay on this device

vault.empty: No documents yet. Create the first one below.

vault.deleteConfirmBody: Delete "{{title}}"? You can undo it right after.
vault.deleteFolderConfirmBody: Delete "{{name}}"? The documents inside aren't deleted — they just stop being in a folder.
vault.archivedEmpty: Deleted documents show up here — you can restore any of them.
vault.invitesEmpty: When someone invites you to a document by email, it shows up here until you accept or decline.

share.title: Share
share.hint: Whoever you invite can read it. No one outside this list can.
share.linkHint: Anyone with the link joins the document at the chosen role, no email invite needed.
share.removeConfirmBody: Remove {{name}}? They lose access to every edit from this point on — a fresh key replaces the one they had. What they've already seen, they've already seen; this can't undo that.
share.grantAccessKeyChanged: {{name}}'s identity key changed since you last saw it — access wasn't granted. Ask them to confirm the change before trying again.
share.leaveConfirmBody: Leave? You'll lose access immediately and need a new invite to come back.

editor.sigilHint: This sigil represents this document's key — it should look the same for everyone with access.
editor.keyPending: Waiting for a member to share the document key with you…
editor.disconnectedBanner: Reconnecting — new changes aren't saved anywhere else yet.
editor.deleteCommentConfirmBody: Delete this comment? This can't be undone.
editor.updateVerificationFailed: An update failed verification and was discarded — it may have been tampered with

history.empty: No history yet — write something first.

restoreModal.title: Restore this version?
restoreModal.body: This version's text becomes the current one. Newer versions stay in the history.

settings.identityHint: Compare this sigil and fingerprint with whoever invited you, over a different channel (a call, a message), to confirm nobody's in the middle.
settings.devicesNote: Logging out a device ends that browser's session immediately — it'll need to log in again.
settings.deviceRevokeConfirmBody: Log out {{name}}? That session ends right away.
settings.revokeOtherDevicesConfirmBody: Every device except this one loses access right away — each will need to log in again.
settings.changePhraseNote: Change your password without losing access to your documents — your keys get re-encrypted, not recreated.
settings.exportAllNote: With no password recovery, this is the only backup you can make of your own account.
settings.exportAllEmpty: No documents could be exported right now
settings.revokeOtherDevicesNote: Keeps this device signed in, logs every other one out.

errors.invalid_refresh_token: session expired, please log in again
errors.rate_limited: too many attempts, try again later
errors.not_owner: only the owner can do this
errors.not_member: you're not a member of this document
errors.not_comment_author: only the comment's author or the document owner can do this
errors.keys_not_found: this user hasn't published identity keys yet
errors.private_keys_not_found: no private keys published for this user
errors.pending_wrapped_dek: nobody has wrapped this document's key for you yet
errors.cannot_remove_owner: the owner can't remove themselves from the document
errors.incomplete_rotation: the key rotation must wrap the new key for every remaining member
errors.snapshot_not_found: this document has no snapshot yet
errors.already_invited: this person already has a pending invite for this document
errors.invite_stale: this document's key changed since the invite was sent — cancel it and invite this person again

keyChangeWarning.title: Identity key changed
keyChangeWarning.body: {{subject}}'s identity key is different from the one this device last saw. This could be a new device — or someone tampering with your connection.
keyChangeWarning.hint: Compare this sigil and fingerprint with them over a different channel (a call, a message) before continuing. If they don't match, stop and don't proceed.
